targets.title: The relation between perception and behavior, or how to win a game of Trivial Pursuit.
targets.evidence_quote: Multilab direct replication of: A variant of Experiment 4 from Dijksterhuis, A., & van Knippenberg, A. (1998).
targets.outcome_quote: We observed no overall difference in trivia performance between participants primed with the “professor” category and those primed with the “hooligan” category (0.14%) and no moderation by gender.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The planned multilab comparison showed no overall priming effect; the discussion expressly summarizes no overall effect.

reasoning: Completed data collection across laboratories tests one published original paper. Unpublished protocol-check replications supply procedures and comparisons but are not additional published target papers. Background priming studies and prior failed replications are not re-tested targets.
